name: all48_sampled_dataset_construction_groundedsam_reference_v1
intent: Reference Grounded-SAM option snapshot used by the all-48 sampled dataset-construction experiment.

eye_region_mask_contract.description: The experiment stores eye-region masks by rasterizing the resolved Grounded-SAM eye ROI bbox.

notes: This experiment does not use Grounded-SAM to generate pupil geometry.
Pupil mask, bbox, and state are generated only from raw CSV positive ellipse supervision.
CSV region-zero rows are treated as state-only, not geometry-complete.
